newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $1.196 bln so far in November.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $1.196 bln so far in November.

text.p: Brazil exported $1.196 billion in goods in the first six working days of November, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
Average daily exports for the month so far were $199.4 million after exports of $938 million in November's second week. Average daily exports in the second week were $187.6 million, she said.
October's trade balance, which some see as a deficit of more than $1.0 billion, was due to be announced later this week.
